sites.description: City centre office. Its cell is never flooded in the data: a dry reference.
Logistics hub west of Bordeaux, dry. Logistics uses the industrial damage curve.
Plant on the Garonne bank, flooded in some simulated years.
Warehouse at the Isle and Dordogne confluence: the most exposed site.
Plant on the upstream Garonne: frequent but shallow floods.
Wine estate, part 1 of 2: cellars, equipment and wine stock. Hillside, but its cell covers the plain.
Wine estate, part 2 of 2: the vines, at the same point, with the crop curve.
Office on the estuary bank: its own cell has no data, a neighbour cell is used.
Offshore, 12.9 km from any cell: excluded, river flood data says nothing at sea.
Outside the zone served by this deployment: excluded.
